Example Developments Ltd. proposed a six-storey mixed-use building at 45999 Example Street, comprising 82 residential units and ground-floor commercial space. The rezoning shifts the land to C9 (Mid Rise Apartment Commercial).

The project drew neighbourhood feedback on traffic and parking, and was approved by council after a public hearing.
